body.def: \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}(P,\eta)\) is the union of the Collins projection polynomials generated from \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}\) and from every two-copy target-nonconstancy system comparing it with \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s',\sigma'}\), after all coordinates \(y,y'\) are eliminated and only \(P,\eta\) remain
